description: Telegram MTProto user and bot API; sources only detail user auth and the paid Gateway API.
auth_notes: MTProto sessions use an auth_key_id after phone-code login; Gateway API uses an access token as Authorization Bearer or access_token parameter. Bot login steps not shown.
gate_detail: Gateway access token is obtained in Gateway account settings, with per-message charges (free to your own number). How to obtain MTProto API credentials or bot tokens is not stated in the sources.
api_scope: MTProto user authorization via auth.sendCode with schema-defined methods; separate HTTP Gateway API for verification messages; Mini Apps init-data auth uses bot token HMAC.
mcp_notes: No vendor MCP server in sources; MCP mentions relate to unrelated third parties.
blocker_detail: Main Telegram API and bot credential path is not evidenced; Gateway is a narrow, usage-charged verification service.

evidence.quote: Authorization is associated with a client's encryption key identifier: auth_key_id .
Before invoking API methods, you must obtain an access token in the Telegram Gateway account settings.
in the HTTP header: Authorization: Bearer <token>
The Gateway API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers looking to deliver automated messages, such as verification codes, to users who registered their phone number on Telegram.
Charges will apply according to the pricing plan for each successful message delivery.

uncertainties: Bot API tokens and api_id registration are not described in sources
Gateway webhook support inferred from callback_url reports, not a full webhook description
Whether Gateway is the intended product for core.telegram.org is unclear
